reveal_lines: The Crawling Chaos remembers.
Turn 1, as you arrived on a level: whisper 1 (ambient) was admitted.
Telegraph: "A distant whisper brushes against your thoughts."
Effect: an omen only; no rule changed.
Delivered: yes, "The shadows lean closer." was shown with the telegraph.
Spent at once.
Motif: the whistle, 2 programs, felt 1 time.
Turn 345: next-use program 1 was admitted.
Origin: you whistled on DL2 on turn 335.
Rebound: first written about an earlier one (turn 13).
Telegraph: "For a while, your whistles may carry farther than they should."
Effect: for a while, any whistle could answer it, at most 2 times.
Delivered: yes, 2 times; you saw your companion answer the whistle.
Ended: its uses ran out or it expired before the game ended.
Turn 1016: next-use program 2 was admitted.
Origin: you whistled on DL2 on turn 997.
Rebound: first written about an earlier one (turn 592).
Recurrence: "Again, the whistle carries farther than it should."
Telegraph: "For a while, your whistles may carry farther than they should."
Effect: for a while, any whistle could answer it, at most 2 times.
Delivered: no; no manifestation reached you.
Ended: its uses ran out or it expired before the game ended.
Turn 1016, as you prayed: whisper 2 (door_reluctance) was admitted.
Telegraph: "The doors of this place seem to lean against you."
Effect: closed doors resisted you more often, for 192 turns.
Delivered: no; a rule change has no separate manifestation.
Ended: expired on turn 1208.
Admitted 4, delivered 2; cruelty spent 3.
